node.title: Re^2: How to extract a pattern in Perl regex?
node.author: SergioQ
node.doctext:
Yes, I'm looking at the recommended methods, and that "^" was a typo.

However part of my question was how do I extract in one statement what's in between the "title tags".

The way I worked around it was:

$result = =~ /(.*<\/title>)/mgi; my $newresult = $1; $newresult =~ s/<title>//i; $newresult =~ s/<\/title>//i; </code> <p>Surely there's a simpler way?</p>
